text:
laura: heads up — PR #627 is queued for a docs merge tomorrow AM. it touches the Private deployment migration guide, SDK examples, and a few diagrams. need a quick style + assets check before i approve. tagging @ethan @priya

priya: happy to review. what are the known concerns?

laura: 1) tone oscillates between 'we' and 'you' in the migration steps 2) product naming inconsistent (Private vs Redwood Private vs private deploy) 3) some images 404 in preview 4) JS/TS samples diverge — one uses promises, other async/await.

ethan: saw the preview yesterday — images under `assets/diagrams/` were linked with `./assets/diagrams/` which the static builder rewrites weirdly. quick fix is to use `/docs/assets/diagrams/...` or the {{ site.baseurl }} helper.

priya: for tone i suggest imperative instructions (You do X) for step-by-step migrations and use we for high-level rationale only. also we should avoid contractions in formal migration docs per styleguide.

laura: agreed. also the headers use sentence case in some sections and Title Case in others. pick sentence case per docs style.

ethan: on samples — here's the current discrepancy:
```javascript
// js (old)
client.generate({ input: prompt }).then(r => console.log(r))
// ts (new)
const response = await client.text.generate({ input: prompt })
console.log(response)
```
we should normalize to async/await for both and show minimal auth setup.

priya: i'll do a pass for voice/tense and header casing. i'll grep for product-name variants: `rg "\bPrivate\b|\bprivate deploy\b|\bRedwood Private\b" docs/ -n` and normalize to "Redwood Private" where referring to the product.

laura: perfect. ethan can you handle the asset links and sample parity? try to keep snippets copy-paste friendly and include imports.

ethan: yup. i'll replace promise chain with async/await and add the import lines. also i'll add a one-line note about auth: `const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`

priya: quick nit: remove sentences like "You will be able to..." -> "After completing these steps, your deployment will...". less promotional, more factual.

docs-bot: docs preview deployed — https://deploy-preview-627--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: partial; 1 asset missing)

ethan: preview shows the missing images still. looks like one image path has an extra `../` in the markdown frontmatter. pushing a tiny fix now.

laura: ETA for fixes? we need to merge in the 9am PT slot.

priya: i'll push voice + casing changes in a follow-up commit in ~20m. i'll run docs-lint locally and attach the report.

ethan: pushed asset path fix and updated JS/TS snippets to both use async/await + import lines. added a short migration-note about client surface change (`client.text.generate`).

docs-bot: docs preview updated — https://deploy-preview-627--docs.redwood-inference.dev (status: success)

priya: ran docs-lint: small warnings only (line-length in code block & passive voice in one paragraph i missed). pushed a fix for passive voice.

laura: reviewing preview now. two small nits: 1) in the migration checklist please bold the critical step to rotate keys 2) add a short cross-ref link to the Dedicated guide where we mention capacity planning.

ethan: added bold on rotation step and a cross-ref link.

priya: also added a doc note under the style checklist to avoid marketing phrases like "best-in-class" unless we have a citation. saved as inline comment for the PR.

laura: great. i approve pending changelog entry. please add one line to docs/CHANGELOG.md: "Migration guide: tone & naming cleanup; sample parity for SDKs; fix diagram assets"

ethan: changelog added, will merge at 9:00am PT. i'll watch the deploy and confirm the prod route flush.

priya: one follow-up ticket: add a linter rule to catch inconsistent product-name variants in docs (linking to internal board ticket DOCS-98). i'll create it after merge.

laura: thanks all. nice quick turnaround. closing once merged. :white_check_mark:
